# move_llm_file_tool

> Move files or directories to a new location in the LLM file system.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `data` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default); grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=move_llm_file_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Move files or directories to a new location in the LLM file system.

SUPPORTED OPERATIONS:
- Move one or more files to a target directory (by file IDs)
- Move an entire directory and all its contents to a new path

MOVING FILES:
Provide file_ids (array of integers) and target_directory to move specific files.
Example: {file_ids: [10, 11, 12], target_directory: "/archive/2024"}

MOVING A DIRECTORY:
Provide source_directory and target_directory to move an entire directory tree.
All files and subdirectories within the source are moved to the new location.
Example: {source_directory: "/projects/old-project", target_directory: "/archive/old-project"}

NOTES:
- Target directories are auto-created if they don't exist
- You must provide either file_ids OR source_directory, not both
- Use list_llm_files_tool first to find file IDs or verify paths

CROSS-TENANT: moves are OWN-TENANT ONLY. A file shared from another tenant cannot be
moved (even with an editor share — reorganizing is the owning tenant's concern); use
update_llm_file_tool for content/title changes on shared files.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file_ids` | array of integer | no | Array of LlmFile IDs to move. Use list_llm_files_tool to find IDs. |
| `source_directory` | string | no | Directory path to move (moves the entire directory and contents). Example: "/projects/old". |
| `target_directory` | string | yes | Destination directory path (required). Example: "/archive/2024". |
